## 维护者速读
改了什么：记录详情页「显示 N 个空字段」从各分区各自、刷新即忘的开关，改为当前用户对该对象的一个选择：点一次，该对象详情页所有分区都显示空字段，换记录、刷新、换设备都保持;其它对象不受影响。存在 `sys_user_preference` 的 `ui.record.OBJECT` 行，与列表页 `ui.list.OBJECT` 同机制、同一次偏好读取。
为什么改:#25883 第 2 项：商机页三个分区要点三次，刷新或打开下一条商机又全部折叠。第 1 项已在 #26325 落地。
风险与回滚：没有偏好服务(未登录、宿主未挂桥接)时行为与原来一致(各分区内存态);作者声明的全空隐藏不会因这个选择被显示出来(有测试);控制台启动的偏好读取仍是一次请求。回滚 = revert 本 PR,已写入的 `ui.record.*` 行无人读取、无害。
先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` 的 `rememberedShowEmpty` → `ui/packages/react/src/context/RecordPagePreferencesContext.tsx` → `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/RecordPreferencesProvider.tsx` 与 `ConsoleShell.tsx` 的挂载处。
两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.emptyFieldsRemembered-25883.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/RecordPreferencesProvider-25883.test.tsx`,预期全过。
需要你做的：无，席位落地。
席位意见:ACCEPT。接缝放在 `@object-ui/react` 的新 context,plugin-detail 不依赖 app-shell,没有新增包依赖。整页全空时那一行折叠(`EmptySectionsFold`)仍是内存态，不在本卡范围，记为后续。

## 席位核对
seat 2 · 2026-10-27T09:00Z · head `2646abdc` (#25883 item 2)

| item | reading |
|---|---|
| form | 10 files, +770/−50: `DetailSection.tsx` reads/writes `showEmptyFields` for `objectName` through `useRecordPagePreferences` (falls back to its own state with no store or no object name), and the authored all-empty hide now holds whatever the choice; new `@object-ui/react` `RecordPagePreferencesContext` (shaped like `HostNavigationContext`); app-shell `RecordPreferencesProvider`, a `recordState` slot on `UserStateAdapters`, the `ui.record.` family mounted in `ConsoleShell` inside `ListPreferencesProvider` (~70 lines are re-indent); two pins; `consoleUserPreferenceBudget` restated for the second prefix in the same one read; root `.changeset/` patch on react, plugin-detail, app-shell |
| premise measured | on main the toggle was per-section `useState`; `data-objectstack`'s shared preference read already takes several prefixes, so `userState.ts` is unchanged; `ui.list.OBJECT` is not reused because `sanitizeObjectListPreference` drops non-list fields |
| gates (check-runs on `2646abdc`) | 45 success, 9 skipped, 0 failing (Test UI 16/16, Build & E2E UI, Type Check UI and debt ledger, Lint UI, Check PR Size, governed guard all green). Local: red 4/6 at `1b034058` (seam + pin, `DetailSection` unchanged; the two passing cells are the no-store / no-objectName old behaviour), green after; plugin-detail 310 files / 2876 tests; 25 app-shell files / 201 tests; type-check exit 0 for react, plugin-detail, app-shell; `check-sdui-manifest` exit 0; derived gates 33 run (32 exit 0; `ui scripts/` vitest 3 timeouts under load, the 3 files re-run alone 113/113), `check:type-check-debt` not measured locally, left to CI |
| accepted deviations | red leg run outside the lock after three lock timeouts (single file, `--maxWorkers=1`); file surface wider than the claim named (react context + index export, app-shell `UserStateAdapters.tsx`, `ConsoleShell.tsx`), within the claim's "preference seam" clause; the seventh cell (`hideEmpty` guard) is a regression guard added with the fix, not a red-first pin |
| out of scope | `EmptySectionsFold` (the page-level all-empty line) stays in-memory; follow-up only if it is reported as a gap |
| landing | not governed (`check-governed-merges`: 820 changed lines, no hit paths); `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` 1080f074 clean; no other open PR touches `DetailSection.tsx`, `ConsoleShell.tsx`, `UserStateAdapters.tsx` or the react context index; `Fixes #25883` closes the card (item 1 landed in #26325) |
